common.architecture: FilamentUNet: ConvNeXt-Tiny encoder (timm convnext_tiny.dinov3_lvd1689m, DINOv3-distilled init) + U-Net decoder (256/128/64/32) + full-resolution stem; heads: filament mask, filament spine
common.training_data: MAGFiLO folds 1-4 (566 images); fold 0 (141 images) held out for validation
common.optimiser: AdamW lr 3e-4 (encoder x0.1), weight decay 1e-4, batch 1 x accumulation 2, cosine to 0, AMP with fp32 encoder
common.loss: BCE + 0.5 per-instance Dice + 0.5 image Dice + 0.5 Skeleton Recall (drawn spine) + 0.3 spine-head BCE
common.hardware: one NVIDIA Tesla T4 (Kaggle), 13-17 min per epoch

ensemble.combination: mean of sigmoid probabilities over 3 members x 4 flips
ensemble.note: single members score 0.437-0.449 with their own filters; the ensemble is the only change that cleared the +0.005 adoption bar

v24.targets: medoid annotator (the record agreeing most with the others)
v24.augmentation: D4 rotations/flips, gamma, blur, noise, CLAHE strength
v24.schedule: 35 epochs requested; stopped by the session budget after 23; best validated epoch (17) kept

trained_by.run: 23 of 35 epochs (stopped by the 8 h budget); best fold-0 epoch 17 kept
trained_by.weights_chain: version 24 output checkpoint -> private dataset alok158/solar-filament-blend-models (v24.pt, fp32) -> weights/v24.fp16.pt (provenance/build_release_weights.py)

v27.targets: a random annotator record per sample (label augmentation)
v27.augmentation: v24 + rotation +-15 deg and scale +-12.5% on half of the samples

trained_by.run: 26 of 26 epochs (8.7 h session); best fold-0 epoch 21 kept
trained_by.weights_chain: version 27 output checkpoint -> private dataset alok158/solar-filament-blend-models (v27.pt, fp32) -> weights/v27.fp16.pt (provenance/build_release_weights.py)

v31.schedule: 30 epochs, final epoch kept (no selection on validation images)

trained_by.run: 30 of 30 epochs (one 9.8 h session); final epoch kept
trained_by.weights_chain: version 31 output checkpoint -> private dataset alok158/solar-filament-blend-models (v31.pt, fp32) -> weights/v31.fp16.pt (provenance/build_release_weights.py)

common.architecture: FilamentUNet with a 7-channel stem and one head (ConvNeXt-Tiny DINOv3 encoder, first convolution adapted the timm way)
common.input: 128 x 384 crop per kept filament, rotated so its long axis is horizontal, native 2048 px scale (shrunk only to fit): background-normalised, CLAHE, ridge (native resolution), ensemble mask and spine probabilities, the filament (seed), the other kept filaments
common.target: per pixel, the share of the annotators who drew this filament that mark the pixel
common.training_data: 12,683 crops from the ensemble maps of folds 1-4 (decode levels 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7, candidates some annotator drew); fold 0 never seen
common.optimiser: AdamW lr 2e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 24, 1-epoch warm-up then cosine, 16 epochs, AMP with fp32 encoder
common.inference: mean of 2 seeds x 4 flips, threshold 0.40, paste-back keeps seed-touching components, conflicts to the higher probability
common.hardware: one NVIDIA Tesla T4 per seed (Kaggle), both seeds at once, 82 min

adoption_experiment.note: a separately trained pair (same recipe and crops) that decided the adoption

system.note: ensemble + no-merge decode + instance filter + stage-2 refiner; the committed notebook run, submitted 2026-11-14 (public LB 0.40)
